name: How can I add more storage to a small bathroom without overcrowding it?

mainEntity.name: How can I add more storage to a small bathroom without overcrowding it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Improving storage in a compact bathroom usually involves utilizing vertical height and recessed wall cavities. Effective solutions include swapping a shallow vanity for a model with deep drawers, installing recessed medicine cabinets that sit flush between wall studs, and adding floating shelves above the toilet. In the bathing area, building recessed tile shower niches adds practical storage without encroaching on elbow room. A practical tradeoff to consider is recessed versus surface-mounted units: recessed options preserve open sightlines but require evaluating wall depth and verifying that plumbing lines or electrical wiring are not obstructing the cavity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Utilize vertical wall space and recessed framing by adding deep-drawer vanities, built-in medicine cabinets, floating shelving, and recessed shower niches.
